item.tib: khro rgyal lha rgod thog pa snang srid zil gnon gyi dgra bgegs phung zhing brlag pa'i zlog gzhung
item.coloph: khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i zlog gzhung chen mo 'di yang mtshungs med 'gran bral shes rab dgongs rgyal gyis/ gdan sa khyad 'phags sman ri'i bla brang du gtan la phab pa 'dis/ 'gal zla'i bgegs bzlog 'dzam gling bstan pa'i rgyu gyur cig/
